tasks.title: Apna pehla product catalog mein add karein
tasks.title_en: Add your first product to the catalog
tasks.reason: Aapke account mein abhi 0 products hain — bina catalog ke koi buyer aapko dhundh hi nahi sakta. Account sirf 0 din purana hai, isliye yeh pehla aur sabse zaroori step hai. Expected benchmark ke hisaab se is age mein ~3 products hone chahiye.
tasks.reason_en: Your account currently has 0 products — without a catalog, no buyer can find you. At account age 0 days, the expected benchmark is ~3 products already listed. This is the single most critical first step.
tasks.rep_action: Call ke dauran seller ke saath screen share karein aur live product listing form open karein. Product name, category, aur ek basic description fill karwayen — submit button tak saath chalein.

tasks.title: Profile verification ke liye documents upload karein
tasks.reason: Aapki profile abhi unverified hai (paid_history=False). IndiaMART pe verified sellers ko buyers zyada trust karte hain, aur Red-tier health score (26/100) ka ek bada reason yahi verification gap hai. Yeh ek baar ka 10-minute kaam hai.
tasks.reason_en: Your profile is currently unverified (paid_history=False). Verified sellers receive significantly more buyer trust on IndiaMART, and this verification gap is one of the key reasons your composite health score is 26/100 (Red). This is a one-time 10-minute task.
tasks.rep_action: Call pe verification documents ki checklist share karein (GST certificate, business address proof). Seller ko batayein kaunse documents acceptable hain aur upload portal ka link directly send karein WhatsApp pe.

tasks.title: Products ki high-quality photos add karein
tasks.title_en: Add high-quality photos to your products
tasks.reason: CQS score abhi measure nahi ho sakta kyunki products hi nahi hain, lekin jaise hi products add honge, photos na hone se CQS 70 ke threshold se neeche rahega. Good photos se buyer ka trust badhta hai aur inquiry milne ki chance kaafi zyada hoti hai.
tasks.reason_en: Your CQS cannot be measured yet because there are no products, but once listed, missing photos will keep your CQS below the Green threshold of 70. Quality photos are the single biggest driver of buyer inquiry conversion.
tasks.rep_action: Seller ko samjhayein ki phone se bhi achhi photos li ja sakti hain — plain white/light background, natural light, aur multiple angles. IndiaMART ke photo guidelines ka screenshot WhatsApp pe bhejein. Pehle product ke saath hi photos upload karwayen.

tasks.title: Notifications aur reply settings ON karein
tasks.reason: Aapka current reply rate 0% hai jabki 1589 BLs reply mein hain — yeh data inconsistency suggest karta hai ki notifications properly set nahi hain ya app active nahi hai. Red category demand mein har ek inquiry precious hai, koi bhi miss nahi hona chahiye.
tasks.reason_en: Your current reply rate shows 0% against 1589 BLs in reply — this data inconsistency strongly suggests notifications are not properly configured or the app is not active. In a Red-demand category with 0.0 BLs per paid seller, every single inquiry is precious.
tasks.rep_action: Call pe seller ka IndiaMART app open karwayen. Settings > Notifications section mein jayen aur 'Buy Lead Alerts' aur 'Message Notifications' dono ON hain yeh confirm karein. App notification permissions phone settings mein bhi check karein.

tasks.title: Company profile 100% complete karein
tasks.reason: Company name aur city jaise basic details abhi bhi blank hain. Ek incomplete profile se buyers confidence nahi paate aur search ranking bhi kam hoti hai. Yeh kaam sirf ek baar karna hai aur 10 minute se kam mein ho jaata hai.
tasks.reason_en: Basic details like company name and city are currently blank. An incomplete profile reduces buyer confidence and lowers your search ranking on IndiaMART. This is a one-time task completable in under 10 minutes.
tasks.rep_action: Seller ke saath Company Profile section open karein. Company name, city/location, business type, aur year of establishment fill karwayen. 'Profile Completeness' percentage indicator dikhayein aur 80%+ tak pahunchne ka target set karein is call pe hi.

activation_plan.opening_pitch_hi: Namaste! Main aapka IndiaMART onboarding coach bol raha hoon — aapka account abhi bilkul naya hai aur hum milke is pehle hafte mein aapki profile ko buyers ke liye ready banayenge. Abhi aapka health score 26/100 hai, lekin sirf 3-4 chote steps se hum ise is hafte mein kaafi improve kar sakte hain.

data.llm_justification: The combination of zero active days, zero reply rate, zero enquiries, and zero hotleads over 30 days represents a near-total disengagement from the platform, which the rule-based model underweights at only 28. The sole anomaly — 3244 clickstream events — likely reflects automated crawlers, passive browsing, or residual system activity rather than genuine seller engagement, making it a misleading positive signal that the compound multiplier of 1.0 fails to discount.
llm_interactions: Zero active days + zero reply rate + zero enquiries form a complete activity blackout, compounding churn risk beyond individual flag weights

3244 clickstream events contradicts all engagement metrics (0 replies, 0 active days, 0 hotleads), suggesting bot/automated traffic rather than real seller intent — a false positive the rule model likely treated neutrally
Reply rate of 0% against 1589 historical replies suggests an account that was once active but has now fully disengaged, indicating a sharp behavioral cliff rather than a never-active account
Absence of BL velocity, PNS answer rate, CQS, and RAG data compounds uncertainty — missing signals in an already-disengaged profile skew toward higher churn risk
